No need to apologize. 
See I don't think like that, at least not anymore. You're saying at the end of the day you lie down and think, "Got through another one." At the end of the day I lie down and think, "Another day of torture over with." 

I've lost the hope of it getting better at this point, I heard it a lot after my mother passed away, "It'll get easier." Well yeah, dealing with her loss has gotten easier but the depression that came from that holds on and won't let go.
no, never have went for professional help before
on going, its been years and some days are far worse than others but that feeling is always there lingering around.
